title: Which Support Platforms Sync With HubSpot and Salesforce? (2026) | Pylon
summary: Which help desks sync with HubSpot and Salesforce? Sync direction, account data, and plan prices for Pylon and 7 others, from vendor docs, Nov 2026.
body_markdown:
**Short answer:** Most help desks connect to HubSpot and Salesforce, but the sync direction varies a lot. Pylon syncs data both ways with Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, and Pipedrive on every plan: fields flow into Pylon or out to the CRM. It also logs AI summaries of customer conversations to the CRM account each day and adds new channel contacts to the CRM. Zendesk, Front, and Help Scout mostly pull CRM data in one direction. Intercom and Freshdesk offer two-way options with limits or add-ons. HubSpot Service Hub and Salesforce Service Cloud are native to their own CRM.

## What does "syncs with your CRM" actually mean?


**Short answer:** Check four things: which direction data moves, which objects move (contacts, accounts, deals, cases), how often, and whether support activity lands on the CRM account.


- **One-way pull:** CRM data shows up in the help desk, but nothing goes back.
- **One-way push:** the help desk creates leads, cases, or activity in the CRM.
- **Two-way field sync:** chosen fields update in both systems.
- **Activity logging:** support conversations appear on the CRM record so sales and success teams see them.


For B2B teams, the account is what matters. A support issue should show the account's plan, owner, and renewal stage, and the CRM should show what the account has been asking about.


## How does Pylon sync with Salesforce?


**Short answer:** Field sync into Pylon or out to Salesforce, daily AI activity summaries on the Account, contact sync from customer channels, and Slack channel creation from Salesforce.


- **Account matching** by domain and name, or by custom fields.
- **Activity sync:** each day Pylon summarizes customer conversations with AI and syncs the summary to the matching Salesforce Account.
- **Field sync:** sync fields from Pylon to Salesforce or from Salesforce to Pylon. Synced fields work in views, triggers, and macros.
- **Contact sync:** when someone new joins a customer channel, Pylon adds them to Salesforce and links them to the Account.
- **Create Slack Channel** from Salesforce, inviting the Opportunity Contact Roles.
- **Broadcasts** filtered by Salesforce data.


Source:[Pylon Salesforce docs](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/integrations/crm/salesforce) .


## How does Pylon sync with HubSpot?


**Short answer:** The same core sync as Salesforce: fields flow into Pylon or out to HubSpot, daily AI activity summaries on the HubSpot account, and contact sync.


Pylon connects to HubSpot with a service key. The Pylon card on HubSpot records (account cards and Create Channel) isn't available with a service key connection; workspaces already connected through the Pylon app in HubSpot keep it. You can filter issues by HubSpot data and send broadcasts based on it. Source:[Pylon HubSpot docs](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/integrations/crm/hubspot) .


## Does Pylon work with Attio and Pipedrive?


**Short answer:** Yes. Both get daily AI activity summaries, field sync into Pylon or out to the CRM, contact sync, and broadcast filtering. With Pipedrive you can also segment analytics by Pipedrive fields. Sources:[Attio docs](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/integrations/crm/attio) ,[Pipedrive docs](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/integrations/crm/pipedrive) .


## How do Zendesk, Freshdesk, and Intercom compare?


**Short answer:** All three connect to Salesforce, but their syncs are one-way per object or need an add-on.


- **Zendesk:** Salesforce accounts and contacts sync one-way into Zendesk. A separate Zendesk sync sends requests to Salesforce Cases one-way, and closed ones don't sync.
- **Freshdesk:** the Salesforce Connector app shows CRM records in the issue view and can create them. Two-way contact and account sync uses the paid Connector apps add-on.
- **Intercom:** the Salesforce app syncs mapped attributes in the direction you choose per attribute. Intercom's HubSpot app only sends data to HubSpot; for two-way sync, Intercom points to Data Sync by HubSpot.


## How do Help Scout and Front compare?


**Short answer:** Both show CRM data next to the conversation and pull contacts in, but don't push field changes back.


Help Scout includes HubSpot and Salesforce on Plus and Pro, with a one-way profile sync from Salesforce and the option to log conversations to CRM activity. Front's plugin is on all plans; contact and account sync (one-way into Front) is on Professional and above.


## Should you use the CRM's own help desk?


**Short answer:** If your company runs fully on one CRM and the support team is happy in it, HubSpot Service Hub or Salesforce Service Cloud avoids a sync entirely. If your customers reach you in Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email, a B2B help desk with two-way CRM sync usually fits better.


## FAQ


**Which help desks have two-way sync with Salesforce?**


Pylon (fields sync into Pylon or out to the CRM, plus daily activity logging to the CRM account), Intercom (each attribute in one chosen direction), and Freshdesk (contacts and accounts, with a paid add-on). Zendesk, Front, and Help Scout document one-way syncs.


**Which help desks have two-way sync with HubSpot?**


Pylon syncs data both ways with HubSpot: fields flow into Pylon or out to HubSpot, and conversation summaries log to the HubSpot account daily. Intercom's own app is one-way, with two-way through HubSpot's Data Sync app. Front and Help Scout pull HubSpot data in.


**Is Pylon's CRM integration an extra cost?**


No. CRM integrations are on every Pylon plan. Professional is $89 per seat per month and Advanced is $139 per seat per month, on an annual contract. Account Intelligence, which adds health scores and Opportunity Sync, is an add-on at $10 per customer account per month (50 account minimum). Source:[usepylon.com/pricing](https://www.usepylon.com/pricing) .


**Does Pylon log support conversations to the CRM?**


Yes. Each day Pylon summarizes customer conversations with AI and syncs the summary to the matching account in Salesforce or HubSpot, the Company in Attio, or the Organization in Pipedrive.


**Can I use CRM data in support workflows?**


In Pylon, synced CRM fields work as filters in views, triggers, and macros, and in broadcast targeting.
